integrity: Proof contains explicit incidence normalization, line-exhaustion argument and exact finite-field verifier; original claims remain subject to independent external validation.
scientific_limitations: Literal integral Schur quartic model in characteristic three; not the distinct good-reduction K3 model. Geometric lines, normalization and point counts proved; full Hilbert line scheme and model-independent specializations not determined.
title: The characteristic-three Schur model is an inseparably normalized quartic scroll
